connect.title: LinkedIn bai kwrwngdi
connect.intro: Nini advertisement no naikolnai LinkedIn account bai sign in khaidi. Leadrat nini ad account, Lead Gen Form advertisement ni mungwi simi se porio, tei nwng swlaijakmani swlaimung rok no rohornai.
connect.need1: LinkedIn ad account o kaisa samung (Nainai eba aboni slai kotor).
connect.need2: Link wngjak company ni page o kaisa samung (Twiphang, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Tẃiphang eba Tẃiphang) - LinkedIn bo tẃiphangrokno rwna nangnai.
connect.need3: Nini Lead Gen Forms o kaisa phone number ni swngmung - phone number kwrwi lead rok no rwwi manliya.
